Additional Comments: Mr. ***** is a 52-year-old male with newly diagnosed metastatic pancreatic cancer, presenting with a significant history of abdominal pain, weight loss, and emesis. Initial imaging revealed a pancreatic cystic lesion greater than 3 cm, a 38mm mass in the pancreatic body, and a 1.4 cm hypoattenuating liver mass. Further imaging showed a 2.8x4.2 cm pancreatic neck mass with associated vascular involvement and additional hepatic lesions. His CA 19-9 level was markedly elevated at 13,737. He has been referred to UCSF for consideration of the Precision Promise clinical trial and has consented to proceed with screening procedures. The patient has been informed about the necessity of birth control during the trial and has reviewed the financial responsibilities and prohibited medication list.
